seed_derivation_note: Single master seed shared by every episode and both arms (the fifo kernel consumes no RNG draws). Selected as the first seed >= 20260906 under which every interior random_unit episode leaves >= 2 never-drawn pool orders; realized draw outcomes are frozen facts recorded per fixture in enrichment_manifest.json.

pool.scaffold_note: Mirrors the S3/EP3 frozen family: m*=4 pool with q_P=(5,4,3,2), two better levels summing to S_<=5, two deeper untouched orders; V*-ladder {1,2,4,6} via aggressor quantity Q in {6,7,9,11}; exhaustion rung at V*=R*=14 via Q=19.

request_stream_note: Identical across both arms of every pair; the clearing episode is the first request, the cancel/replace are post-episode book-maintenance events that exercise the cancel/replace grammar on never-executed untouched-level orders; ambiguous sets are computed at the completion of the aggressor request.

latency_window_rule.name: touched_level_median_straddle
latency_window_rule.definition: For the ambiguous set A at the rationed touched level (never-executed orders on the fifo arm; never-drawn orders on the random_unit arm) with m = |A| >= 2 and arrival clocks sorted ascending c_(1) <= ... <= c_(m): W(A) = c_(ceil(m/2)); m_in = |{i in A : clock_i <= W}|; m_out = m - m_in; clock_straddle iff m_in >= 1 and m_out >= 1.
latency_window_rule.rationale: Guarantees by construction that the latency consumer C_lat^W = sum_i p_i 1{clock_i <= W} q_i has a strictly positive split floor (R^2/3) p^2 (m_in * m_out / m) on random_unit touched levels (theory appendix Theorem 1(e)(ii); ordering O-C) and nonzero orthant exposure on the fifo arm. At V* = R* the touched level has no ambiguous set: W is null and clock_straddle is false.
